name: Late-Game Enemy HP Scaling
description: Scales late-game enemy HP up by the enemy's EXCESS attack-power above the end of the first full book, so the first book stays vanilla and the late game ramps. BA1 (Books 2-3) uses the TAS-observed power table and scales the multi-phase Sphinx (2.4) and Codex (3.10) survival bosses on every phase. BA2 (Books 5-6) computes Lex's power curve from its leveling (P0 = end of Book 4); the curve is leveling-only (no treasures) so it is gentler than BA1 -- raise 'd' for more intensity.
author: you

param_spec.label: Scaling exponent (d)
param_spec.help: Higher = harsher late-game HP. Ships at 0.6; BA2's leveling-only curve is gentle, so try ~1.2 for BA1-like intensity.
